title: Safe Average
description: Sensor readings arrive as a list, and a missing reading is None. Write a function named safe_average that returns the average of the valid readings, or 0.0 when there are none.

hidden_tests.kind: a list containing only None values
a list with negative values and None

hints: Averaging requires filtering valid numeric values and guarding against zero denominators.
Inspect how you filter: you must exclude None values before calculating length or summing.
Attempting sum() on a list containing None will raise a TypeError: unsupported operand type.
Filter valid readings with a list comprehension: valid = [x for x in readings if x is not None]. If not valid, return 0.0.
